documents.title: Remote Work Policy 2025
documents.body:
COMPANY POLICY: REMOTE WORK GUIDELINES 2025

Effective Date: January 1, 2025
Policy Owner: Human Resources
Last Updated: December 15, 2025

1. ELIGIBILITY
All full-time employees with 6+ months tenure are eligible for hybrid remote work. Employees must maintain reliable internet (minimum 50 Mbps download speed) and dedicated workspace.

2. SCHEDULE
Core hours: 10 AM - 3 PM (employee's local timezone) must be available for meetings. Flexible hours outside core time. Maximum 3 remote days per week unless approved by department head.

3. EQUIPMENT
Company provides: Laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse. Employees responsible for: Internet connection, desk, chair, office supplies. IT support available for company-provided equipment only.

4. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS
Mandatory: VPN connection for all work activities, encrypted hard drive, password manager usage, screen lock after 5 minutes idle. Prohibited: Public WiFi without VPN, shared devices, storing company data on personal cloud.

5. COMMUNICATION
Expected response time: Email within 4 hours during core hours, Slack within 30 minutes during core hours, attend all mandatory meetings via video (camera on).

6. PERFORMANCE MONITORING
Managers conduct monthly check-ins, quarterly productivity reviews, annual remote work privilege assessment.

7. VIOLATION CONSEQUENCES
First violation: Written warning. Second violation: 30-day remote work suspension. Third violation: Remote work privilege permanently revoked.

Questions? Contact user@example.com or your manager.

input.code:
require 'digest'

# 1) Get raw content (same resilient digging)
raw_content =
  input['file_content'] ||
  input.dig('Input', 'Data', 'file_content') ||
  input.dig('Data', 'file_content') ||
  input.dig('input', 'data', 'file_content') ||
  input.dig('Input', 'file_content') ||
  input.dig('input', 'file_content')

raise "Missing content input" if raw_content.to_s.strip.empty?

# 2) Parse header + body
lines = raw_content.split(/\r?\n/)
title      = lines[0].to_s.split(": ", 2)[1].to_s.strip rescue nil
url        = lines[1].to_s.split(": ", 2)[1].to_s.strip rescue nil
tags_str   = lines[2].to_s.split(": ", 2)[1].to_s.strip rescue nil
updated_at = lines[3].to_s.split(": ", 2)[1].to_s.strip rescue nil

# Body = everything after the 4 metadata lines
body = lines[4..]&.join("\n").to_s.strip

# 3) Useful normalizations + verifications
tags_array = (tags_str || "").split(",").map { |t| t.strip }.reject(&:empty?)

# Verification helpers to bypass UI truncation
body_length   = body.length
body_sha256   = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(body)
body_head_120 = body[0,120]
body_tail_120 = body[-120,120]

# 4) Return structured result
{
  title: title,
  url: url,
  tags: tags_array,            # array instead of one long string
  tags_raw: tags_str,          # keep original too if you like
  updated_at: updated_at,
  body: body,                  # full text (UI may truncate in display)
  body_length: body_length,    # use this to confirm no truncation
  body_sha256: body_sha256,    # stable fingerprint for integrity checks
  body_preview_start: body_head_120,
  body_preview_end: body_tail_120
}

input.query:
SELECT Id, 
    Account.Name, 
    LastActivityDate,
    Rating,
    AnnualRevenue,
    NumberOfEmployees,
    OwnerId,
    Owner.Name,
    (
        SELECT Id,
      		Name, 
            StageName, 
            Amount, 
            CloseDate,
			NextStep
        FROM Opportunities 
        WHERE StageName NOT IN ('7 - Closed Won','8 - Closed Lost')
        ORDER BY CloseDate DESC
    ),
    (
        SELECT Id,
      		ContractNumber, 
            StartDate, 
            EndDate
        FROM Contracts
        WHERE Status = 'Activated' LIMIT 1
    ),
    (
        SELECT 
            Subject, 
            Status, 
            Description 
        FROM Tasks
        WHERE LastModifiedDate = LAST_N_MONTHS:12
        ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC
    )
FROM Account WHERE  Id = '#{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"salesforce","line":"ce77ff75","path":["Account",{"path_element_type":"current_item"},"Id"]}')}'
